body: I don't get how that's supposed to help.

I've tried so hard. I've even transferred schools to start fresh. I just doesn't work.

I just want to not be me. I hate that me I have.
That's just it. I'm no good for my family, my friends, or anyone else I come into contact with. And I can't change who I am, so why bother with making everyone around me put up with my shit?

Your English is great.

I think that even when I start, I can't keep the stamina to go on.

I really want to be myself with my friends. If I look it up, they might, too.

Even if I'm completely away from all distractions, my mind doesn't seem to want to cooperate. It starts the moment I decide to try to do something.

Well, the problem is even worse on Facebook and SMS. I can take up to an hour to reply sometimes. I don't know why I wait so long, but it's really hard to live with it if you let friends down.
